messages:
elaine: Kickoff — need to align on Observability Console priorities for Q3/Q4. Main asks: dashboards, trace linking, error-analysis, and retention choices. Quick wins vs platform work?

mike: +1. Customer asks piling up — BankCo wants 12mo traces/metrics retention. Cost/SLA concerns.

tara: For BankCo specifically, they also need KMS + full audit logs. That pushes this into Private/compliance territory if we do raw retention.

sanjay: Cost note: full-trace retention at 12mo will blow storage + index costs. Propose: samples + hot/cold tiers. We should produce cost estimates per 100k traces/day.

leo: Hot/cold tiers make sense. Suggested baseline: 30d full fidelity, 11mo sampled summaries (span histograms + aggregate latency profiles). That keeps query UX reasonable.

mike: Quick proposal for launch criteria: (1) Dashboards + trace linking implemented end-to-end, (2) Retention policy + tiering implemented, (3) Dashboard/query perf SLO <=200ms median, 95th <1s, (4) Docs + runbook, (5) Pilot with 2 customers (one regulated).

elaine: +1. Add regression gates: no more than 5% increase in tail latency and cost delta <15% vs current for typical workloads. Also define rollback runbook for retention changes.

tara: Can we commit to a canary rollout for retention compaction and summarization? Need explicit rollback triggers.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: retention-compaction v2 -> prod-standby cluster on 2026-06-15T22:02:31Z :rocket: (logs will be posted to #eng-ops)

sanjay: Technical task list: summarization pipeline, retention compaction worker, query rewrite for sampled/summary data, index TTL enforcement, export hook for long-term archival. I'll add estimates by Thu.

mike: For prioritization matrix (customer value vs effort) my initial ordering: 1) Dashboards + trace linking (value high, effort med), 2) Retention tiering pilot (value high, effort high), 3) Error-analysis UI (value med, effort med), 4) 12mo raw retention (value niche, effort very high) -> defer.

elaine: Decision: Defer offering 12mo raw retention in hosted product. Instead: document a "compliance pack" pattern (sampling + export + Private deployment recommendation). For regulated customers we recommend Private + HSM + export to customer archive.

leo: Notes on UX: queries against sampled summaries must label results clearly and provide link-to-raw when available. Need visual affordances for cold vs hot data.

mike: Action items: Sanjay -> cost model + task estimates by Thu; Mike -> pilot candidate list + sales sync; Tara -> spec for compliance pack + KMS requirements; Elaine -> update OKRs/roadmap and record launch criteria. Reconvene Fri 11:00am to sign off.

elaine: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap doc and append the acceptance criteria and canary plan. If anyone has urgent objections, drop them here; otherwise we'll move these into the sprint planning board.
